name: π0.5 (pi05)

sources.title: Physical Intelligence, π0.5: a Vision-Language-Action Model with Open-World Generalization, arXiv:2504.16054 (HTML version)
sources.covers: the action horizon, the cameras used for high- and low-level inference, the 50 Hz command rate, the PaliGemma backbone, 10 denoising steps

sources.title: openpi (official code), commit 215abfb: src/openpi/models/model.py, pi0.py, pi0_config.py, src/openpi/training/config.py, README.md
sources.covers: IMAGE_RESOLUTION, IMAGE_KEYS, preprocess_observation (resize_with_pad), the SigLIP variant So400m/14, Pi0Config(pi05=True) action_horizon and the pi05 configurations

sources.title: L. Beyer et al., PaliGemma: A versatile 3B VLM for transfer, arXiv:2407.07726
sources.covers: image tokens per image at 224 px

note: openpi runs π0.5 through the same Pi0 model class as π0 (Pi0Config(pi05=True)): every image is resized to 224 × 224 keeping its aspect ratio and padded with black evenly (preprocess_observation, image_tools.resize_with_pad), and the SigLIP encoder is So400m/14. The paper's mobile manipulators have four cameras (forward, backward, two wrists): "We use all four cameras for high-level inference, and the wrist and forward cameras for the low-level inference process"; openpi's three image slots match the low-level set. The action chunk depends on the configuration: Pi0Config's default action_horizon 50 (the paper: "an action horizon of 50"), pi05_droid 15, pi05_libero 10. No inference time is stated in the paper or the README (the README lists an RTX 4090 with more than 8 GB for inference, a memory requirement, not a timing). Code Apache-2.0 (the Gemma weights carry Gemma's terms). DexVantage bundles these figures only, not the model.

input_resolution.quote: IMAGE_RESOLUTION = (224, 224) (src/openpi/models/model.py), used by Pi0Config(pi05=True) through the same Pi0 class

crop_rule.quote: Pi0 calls _model.preprocess_observation, which resizes with image_tools.resize_with_pad(image, *image_resolution)

patch_px.quote: pi0.py: _siglip.Module(... variant="So400m/14" ...) for both π0 and π0.5

tokens_per_image.quote: "We always resize the image to a fixed square size (224, 448, or 896 pixels). This leads to a fixed number of image tokens per model variant (respectively 256, 1024, or 4096 tokens)"

n_cameras.quote: IMAGE_KEYS = ("base_0_rgb", "left_wrist_0_rgb", "right_wrist_0_rgb"); the paper: "the wrist and forward cameras for the low-level inference process"

action_chunk.quote: "an action horizon of 50" (Pi0Config: action_horizon: int = 50; pi05_droid uses 15, pi05_libero 10)

inference_ms.quote: Not stated (the paper gives 10 denoising steps, no timing).

control_hz.quote: "directly commands target poses for the arms, gripper, and torso lift, and the target base velocities at 50 Hz (with action chunking)"
